response.original_title: {FAQ™Room Addition} How Can I Add a Room to My Norwegian Cruise Booking?
response.overview: If you need help with a Norwegian Cruise add a rooms request, +1-866-254-7549 (US) or +44-120-420-8151(UK) our customer service team is ready to assist you by phone or through the official contact channels. In most cases, +1-866-254-7549 (US) or +44-120-420-8151(UK) additional rooms can be added before departure if your cabin has available occupancy and the sailing has not reached +1-866-254-7549 (US) or +44-120-420-8151(UK) its guest limit. Fare differences, taxes, +1-866-254-7549 (US) or +44-120-420-8151(UK) and port fees may apply. Call or contact our support team as early as possible so we can review availability +1-866-254-7549 (US) or +44-120-420-8151(UK) and update your reservation without unnecessary delays.
